paragraphs.notes: Markush enumeration table, recorded as one paragraph per the pass instructions. The cells are compound numbers, substituent symbols and NMR data, not German prose, so zh and en are the same string. The page carries no Tabelle caption and no scaffold drawing; both are on an earlier page. Column headers are printed with superscripts: R with superscript 1, R with superscript 7. The NMR entries are printed with a superscript 1 before H NMR; transcribed here as "1H NMR". The first body row carries no Nr., no R1 and no R7: it is the tail of the Physikalische Daten cell of the last row of the preceding page, continued here. Row 13 has a drawn ring in the R1 cell instead of text; it is recorded in drawings. Rows 18 and 19 are printed with a space between OCH2 and CF2CF2CF3, kept as printed. Rows 16 to 26 have an empty Physikalische Daten cell. The table body ends after row 26; the lower third of the page is blank.

drawings.notes: Belongs to row Nr. 13; it is that row's R1 value, drawn instead of written. The ring is drawn flat with no wedge or hash, so the configuration at C2 is not specified by the drawing. smiles is null because the fragment as drawn has an open valence at the attachment oxygen and no attachment-point notation is used elsewhere in this run; writing OCC1CCCO1 would assert a hydroxyl that the drawing does not show.
